agreement.authority: Repository owner, explicit reply in the #16 implementation conversation
agreement.reference: independent bilinear calculation from decoded source values at the same display coordinates
agreement.crs_approval: Explicit repository-owner reply approving registered native CRS and zero-shift geocentric prototype transform in the #16 implementation conversation, 2026-10-19

orientation: rows north to south, columns west to east
sampling: pixel centres, including one extra pixel centre outside each tile edge

f32.layout: 258*258 little-endian float32 values in row-major order, then 258*258 uint8 validity bytes
f32.validity: 0 missing, 1 valid; missing values encoded as zero

png.layout: RGBA8; unsigned q=(R*65536+G*256+B); value_K=q*0.001; alpha=255 valid, 0 missing
png.compression: lossless PNG/DEFLATE; browser must disable colour conversion and premultiplication

bilinear.source: full-resolution native cells, never COG overviews
bilinear.mask: missing if any contributing cell is missing; no weight renormalization
bilinear.coverage: outside half-open native outer-cell footprint is missing; inside footprint clamp fractional cell indices to edge centres
bilinear.halo: evaluate in global pixel coordinates; neighboring tiles' halo/interior overlaps must agree
bilinear.projection: Inverse EPSG:3857 to WGS84 geodetic lon/lat at height 0, WGS84 geocentric Cartesian, then inverse Cartesian on native sphere R=6371229 m; zero datum shift, Greenwich. Same explicit assumed datum operation as GeoServer EPSG:100001.
bilinear.datum_limit: Owner approved prototype zero-shift geocentric hypothesis on 2026-10-19 after retained angular-placement failure; producer confirmation and desktop QGIS compatibility remain external gates.

readiness.requirements: durable metadata and selected engine/version; deterministic generation and byte hashes on representatives; remaining tiles bounded to zoom 0..6; no global prebuild
